blocks.html:
We’d love to hear from you. Whether you’re ready to book or just have a question, reach out the way that feels easiest. A member of our care team reads every message and replies within one business day.

To book a free 15-minute consult, call us at (305) 555-0142.

For general questions, email us at hello@harbormindtherapy.com.

For insurance and billing, email us at billing@harbormindtherapy.com.

Our office is in Brickell, Miami, open Monday to Friday 8am–8pm and Saturday 9am–2pm. Online sessions are available anywhere in Florida.

Please note that email and voicemail aren’t monitored around the clock. If you are in crisis, call or text 988, the Suicide & Crisis Lifeline, or call 911.
